subject: Onsite training — fare exception & local hotel cap for Boston session
messages:
From: Marco Silva <marco.silva@northbound.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@northbound.com
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 08:14:00 -0400
Subject: Request: onsite training at BOS HQ (Oct 19-20) — travel budget questions

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for outlining the two-day operator training at our Boston HQ (Oct 19-20). We're aligned on scope and would like Redwood to run the labs for ~25 engineers. A couple of procurement items came up:

- Two of our attendees (VPs) will be traveling from London and need business class due to company policy. Our procurement contact flagged that Redwood's travel policy caps economy fares for vendor travel, so we wanted to check if Redwood can approve a one-time fare exception for international business class for these two attendees and confirm whether you can book their airfare directly.
- On local hotels: our standard per-room budget is $280/night; your budget estimate lists $350/night for the recommended venue due to proximity to the training site. Can Redwood approve the $350 cap for up to 6 rooms?

Procurement is looping us in to get pre-approval language and an updated cost estimate so they can issue the PO. Can you share a short formal note that we can attach to the PO and the cost workbook?

Appreciate quick confirmation — we need to finalize by EOD Fri to keep flight inventory for the London legs.

Best,
Marco Silva
Head of Engineering Programs
Northbound Systems

-----Original Attachment(s): northbound_requirements.pdf (PDF)

---
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marco Silva <marco.silva@northbound.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 10:12:23 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: onsite training at BOS HQ (Oct 19-20) — travel budget questions

Marco — thanks, and excited to run this. Short answer up front: we can support booking and seek a one-time exception for the two inbound VPs, and we can request a hotel cap increase for the six rooms, but we need finance sign-off on the nominal overspend. Below is a concise note you can attach to the PO and a link to the cost workbook.

Attachment: northbound_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: cost_estimate_bos.xlsx (XLSX)

Formal pre-approval note for PO (feel free to paste):
Redwood Inference will provide onsite operator training on Oct 19-20, 2026 for Northbound Systems. Redwood will book and invoice travel for two international attendees requiring business class (one-time exception) and will book up to six hotel rooms at the recommended venue at a nightly rate not to exceed $350. Any additional overspend beyond these pre-approved amounts will require separate approval.

Numbers (estimate):
- Training services: $42,500
- Accommodation (6 rooms, 2 nights @ $350): ~$4,200
- Flights (estimate): $12,000 (includes 2x business class legs ATL-LON-ATL)
- Travel contingency & incidentals: $1,500
Total estimated PO: $60,200

Requesting: Vivek, can Finance approve the one-time fare exception and the hotel cap for invoicing? Laura, confirming you sign off on the pre-approval language.

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 617-555-0112

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:03:10 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: onsite training at BOS HQ (Oct 19-20) — travel budget questions

Connor — looks reasonable. Approve the pre-approval language and the hotel cap for up to six rooms at $350/night. For the two business-class tickets: I can approve vendor-booked upgrades for executive attendees if Finance signs off on booked cost center allocation and confirms VAT/invoice handling for international fares. Please get procurement to confirm the PO will include the exact traveler names and that the tickets will be reimbursable to Redwood.

FYI to Proc: we will invoice flights and hotels on the PO and include receipts. If Northbound needs us to book on their ARR/agency, flag it now.

Laura Bennett
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

---
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 13:46:55 -0400
Subject: RE: Request: onsite training at BOS HQ (Oct 19-20) — travel budget questions

Thanks — reviewed numbers. Finance is prepared to authorize a one-time exception for the two inbound business-class tickets under these conditions:

1) Redwood will book the tickets and invoice Northbound directly; we will mark the invoice as "Vendor Travel — Fare Exception NB-77".
2) Procurement must provide the traveler full names and preferred dates within 48 hours of invoice issuance.
3) Any currency/VAT differences will be passed through to Northbound on the invoice (we will not absorb VAT on international fares).
4) Hotel cap of $350/night approved for up to 6 rooms for the two nights; additional rooms or nights require separate approval.

Please confirm the final traveler list and I will issue a short internal authorization memo for our accounting team. Attaching: travel_waiver_nb.docx (DOCX) — this needs a signature from Northbound to confirm fare exception acceptance.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Marco Silva <marco.silva@northbound.com>

Connor — thanks for the clear breakdown and to Laura/Vivek for the approvals. Procurement will: (1) add the pre-approval note to the PO, (2) provide the two traveler names and passport-required details by EOD today, and (3) return the signed travel waiver via DocuSign by close.

We prefer Redwood to handle bookings to avoid duplicate agency fees. Please proceed and share the Concur redirect link you mentioned so our travel admin can coordinate.

Best,
Marco
